t: 英国及其海外属地采用公历。
te: Great Britain, along with its overseas possessions, adopts the Gregorian calendar.
dz: 英国及其海外属地采用公历。
de: Great Britain, along with its overseas possessions, adopts the Gregorian calendar.

t: 大英帝国采用"格雷高历",跳过十一天(前一天是9月2日).
te: The British Empire adopts the Gregorian calendar, skipping eleven days (the previous day was September 2).
dz: 大英帝国采用"格雷高历",跳过十一天(前一天是9月2日).
de: The British Empire adopts the Gregorian calendar, skipping eleven days (the previous day was September 2).
